import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define constants
GSL_MOVSTAT_END_PADVALUE = 0

# Define function prototypes
# gsl_movstat_alloc
gsl.gsl_movstat_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_movstat_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

# gsl_vector_alloc
gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

# gsl_vector_set
gsl.gsl_vector_set.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_vector_set.restype = None

# gsl_vector_get
gsl.gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

# gsl_movstat_mean
gsl.gsl_movstat_mean.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_movstat_mean.restype = None

# gsl_movstat_minmax
gsl.gsl_movstat_minmax.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_movstat_minmax.restype = None

# gsl_vector_free
gsl.gsl_vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_vector_free.restype = None

# gsl_movstat_free
gsl.gsl_movstat_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_movstat_free.restype = None

# gsl_rng_alloc
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

# gsl_rng_default
gsl.gsl_rng_default = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_default")

# gsl_ran_gaussian
gsl.gsl_ran_gaussian.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_ran_gaussian.restype = ctypes.c_double

def moving_statistics(N, K):
    # Allocate workspace and vectors
    w = gsl.gsl_movstat_alloc(K)
    x = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    xmean = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    xmin = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    xmax = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    r = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl.gsl_rng_default)

    # Generate noisy cosine signal
    for i in range(N):
        xi = np.cos(4.0 * np.pi * i / N)
        ei = gsl.gsl_ran_gaussian(r, 0.1)
        gsl.gsl_vector_set(x, i, xi + ei)

    # Compute moving statistics
    gsl.gsl_movstat_mean(GSL_MOVSTAT_END_PADVALUE, x, xmean, w)
    gsl.gsl_movstat_minmax(GSL_MOVSTAT_END_PADVALUE, x, xmin, xmax, w)

    # Collect results
    results = []
    for i in range(N):
        results.append((
            i,
            gsl.gsl_vector_get(x, i),
            gsl.gsl_vector_get(xmean, i),
            gsl.gsl_vector_get(xmin, i),
            gsl.gsl_vector_get(xmax, i)
        ))

    # Free resources
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(x)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(xmean)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(xmin)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(xmax)
    gsl.gsl_movstat_free(w)

    return results

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Small input
    N, K = 10, 3
    results = moving_statistics(N, K)
    assert len(results) == N
    for i, (index, original, mean, minimum, maximum) in enumerate(results):
        assert index == i
        assert isinstance(original, float)
        assert isinstance(mean, float)
        assert isinstance(minimum, float)
        assert isinstance(maximum, float)

    # Test case 2: Larger input
    N, K = 100, 5
    results = moving_statistics(N, K)
    assert len(results) == N

    # Test case 3: Edge case (K > N)
    N, K = 5, 10
    results = moving_statistics(N, K)
    assert len(results) == N

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
